title: Qualify the F8 exit candidate on Mac and iPad
requires: Physical M4 MacBook Air and M1 iPad with Metal deployment access
scope: Qualify only the F8-93 replacement candidate on the registered macOS M4 and iPadOS M1 Metal targets. Verify exact installed Gallery identities, the complete public schedule and affected dispatch-reduction evidence. Preserve scoped F9 scene-quality and timing debt without weakening solver-work limits.
acceptance: Build, sign, deploy and identify the exact frozen source on Mac and iPad, including executable, embedded Metal driver, SDK, manifest, Dock and device runtime hashes.
Pass every applicable capability, 30 public cases, 12 scenarios, numerical/lifecycle/recovery assertion, fixed-work check and negative control in plain and validation modes.
Exercise all 28 Gallery scenes, controls, pause/reset, background/foreground, failure recovery and sustained execution using the shared fixed-tick session and GPU rendering path.

Reconcile native dispatches, workgroups, barriers, spatial builds/publications and public counters against independent F8-54--56 ceilings. Prove no body-count no-op graph, exhaustive coupling search, intra-tick host readback or global host wait reappeared.
Retain all timing samples and stalls. Route allowed scene-quality debt to F9-01--06 and timing debt to F9-07/F9-08 with separate verdicts.
Publish current revisioned Metal capability evidence suitable for the generated public qualification index.
